lines.text: The moon rose high and twinkling stars began dancing across the dark velvet sky!
Time for Leo's three-step cozy bedtime routine that turns sleep into an adventure!
Step one: Warm bubble bath that relaxes tired muscles after a busy day of playing!
Step two: Snuggle into soft flannel pajamas and read two magical bedtime stories!
Step three: Share three things you were grateful for today with a loving bedtime hug!
Gratitude calms your nervous system, slowing down heartbeat into deep peaceful rhythm!
Head on the pillow, eyes closed, drifting on fluffy clouds toward magical dreamland!
Sleep well, little dreamers, tomorrow is full of brand new discoveries and joy!
Sweet dreams from all of us—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
